_readme: Edit, then run `npm run render` (only needed if you change the audio block). Cue names: chime, sparkle, droplet, bloom, whisper, tick, press, release, toggle, success, error, page, loading, ready, pulse, scan, arrival.

done._when: Claude finished its turn and handed control back to you.

needsInput._when: Claude is blocked on you - permission prompt or an agent asking for input.

failed._when: The turn ended on an API error (rate limit, overload, auth).

events._shake: Add "shake": false to any event above to keep its cue silent-but-still.

whenFocused._mode: What to do when the focused window is already Claude Code. full = shake and sound anyway. quiet = sound but no shake. silent = do nothing at all.
whenFocused._titlePattern: Regex matched against the foreground window title. Claude Code sets the terminal title, so this distinguishes tabs, not just the terminal app.

shake._enabled: Shake the whole screen and swallow input while it shakes.
shake._durationMs: How long the shake lasts. It decays to a stop over this window.
shake._amplitude: Peak offset in pixels. 15 is a nudge, 45 is a proper jolt, 90 is absurd.

audio._volume: Peak loudness of the cue, 0-1. 0.32 is comfortable in AirPods, 0.6 is loud.
audio._leadInMs: Near-silent padding in front of the cue so a sleeping Bluetooth link does not swallow the attack. Only used when no media was playing.

media._mode: pause = pause whatever is playing before the cue. none = just play the cue over it.
media._resume: Resume the sessions this tool paused, once the cue has finished.

_cooldownMs: Ignore a second signal fired within this window, so overlapping events do not stack.
